description: Extend WidgetAdapter with optional status/2 and Web.Runtime with bounded confidential-safe validation; implement WebBridge ingress health through existing channel_ingress_status event. Add closed response validator owned by Channels web boundary; no new tool/Action since adapter lifecycle health is local-only and existing domain dispatch is reused. Tests first: ready/start/unavailable/unknown, strict shape, no secrets, timeout/exits, absent callback, disabled and desired/effective mismatch. Docs: web-bridge. Isolated tests and mix q required.
title: Widget adapter readiness and ingress health
